title: First Lessons: Steel
introNarration: Mentor Edge sets your first work. Look this hearth. Find Flint in the South Orchard. Come back.
reminderNarration: Look the Hearth of Steel. Visit the South Orchard. Attack the dummy. Then talk Edge.
completionNarration: Edge nods at your feet, not your sword. Steel has your name, if not yet your stance.

objectives.label: Look around the Hearth of Steel.
